استغبوا (form X)
# اِسْتَغْبَوْا (istaḡbaw) /is.taɣ.baw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَغْبَى (istaḡbā)
# اُسْتُغْبُوا (ustuḡbū) /us.tuɣ.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَغْبَى (istaḡbā)
# اِسْتَغْبُوا (istaḡbū) /is.taɣ.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَغْبَى (istaḡbā)
